<function name="SetDTBool" parent="Entity" type="classfunc">
	<description>
<internal></internal>
This is called internally by the <page>Entity:NetworkVar</page> system, you can use this in cases where using NetworkVar is not possible.

Sets the specified bool on the entity's datatable.
	</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="key" type="number">Goes from 0 to 31.</arg>
		<arg name="bool" type="boolean">The boolean to write on the entity's metatable.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
